rationale: Adopt the 2019-2020 assignment (Fruit drinks -> SSB). USDA moved this code from '100% other fruit juice' to 'fruit drinks', which is a substantive reclassification reflecting that commercial acai 'blends' are sweetened beverages rather than 100% juice. The later assignment is the better-informed one. Note both candidate PDI groups (fruit_juices, ssb) are unhealthy-plant groups, so the direction of the PDI contribution is unchanged; only which of two quintile rankings the item enters. Affects 7 participants.

rationale: Adopt the 2019-2020 assignment (Egg rolls/dumplings/sushi -> not WWEIA-derived). Consistent with the same principle applied to 95342000: prefer USDA's later revision.
